decisive_items: Past medical history included hospitalization in intensive care unit one year ago requiring mechanical ventilation for over 10 days
Prior pulmonary function tests showed severe mixed ventilation dysfunction with FEV1 PreD of 26% and FEV1/FVC percent of 56%
Loud and diffuse wheezing rales in both lungs
response.rationale: Chronic severe asthma is supported by recurrent symptoms, ICU ventilation history, and very low FEV1, while acute wheezing and blood gas abnormalities also fit status asthmaticus but are secondary to the chronic condition.

rejected.why: Normal chest CT contradicts cystic fibrosis, and no specific CF markers are present.
Acute exacerbation features are present, but the long-term severe pulmonary dysfunction and prior ICU ventilation point to severe asthma as the underlying diagnosis.
